what: C1 opening-only retrieval, official structure (black-only candidates and queries, k = 5/10/15/20 x 100), simulated on FIT players only

designs.P120: eligible = fit players with >= 120 black games (any k fits); 40 per level chosen by sha256('<seed>|<player_id>'); k: 100 x each of 5/10/15/20 shuffled with Random('k|<seed>')
designs.P105: eligible = fit players with >= 105 black games; same player choice; k capped at n_black - 100 (smallest caps choose first, draws weighted by remaining counts, 100 of each k)

splits.black_random: player's black games shuffled with Random('pool|<seed>'); candidates = first 100, query = next k
splits.black_fileorder: player's black games in file order; candidates = first 100, query = next k
splits.mixed_random: control (P120 players, same k): all games of both colours shuffled with Random('mixed|<seed>'); candidates = first 100, query = next k

tokens: explore spelling; N = own moves and whole-game moves used; col / nocol / both
metric: rank r of the true player among 400; e^-(r-1) if r <= 5 else 0; top1 / top5 shares
guard: rho = P.pool_open_stats (tools/p02_player_open.py, both sets, p02 parse, raw / canon(mv,10)): median over real queries of max cosO / median over self-retrieval pseudo-queries (sha256 5 parts of 20, k = randint(5,20), 10 rounds); level = P.guard_level with the thresholds in results/prereg02/player/guard_calibration.json
